profiles.name: MiniMax H3 audio + video
profiles.description: Offline MiniMax-H3 generation through audio.cpp release-0.6. The Yeti profile is tuned for a 12 GB RTX 4070: Q4_K, memory saver, layerwise weights, short 480p video, and audio-first defaults.
requirements: audio.cpp release-0.6 audiocpp_cli built with CUDA
NVIDIA driver/toolkit compatible with the audio.cpp CUDA build
notes: The normal Q4_K DiT is the default; the optional INT8 ConvRot package is not selected because audio.cpp reports a higher peak-memory path.
Video defaults to 480p and 121 frames (about five seconds at 24 fps). Use --video to request an RGB24 video artifact.
H3 is experimental and can be slow on 12 GB. Keep other GPU-heavy models unloaded while generating.

profiles.name: LTX-2.5 synchronized video
profiles.description: Text-to-video/audio generation through the official LTX-2.5 DistilledPipeline. The Yeti profile keeps the BF16 checkpoint but casts to FP8 at runtime and offloads to CPU.
requirements: Lightricks/LTX-2 checkout with uv sync --extra natten
Hugging Face access to the gated LTX-2.5 files
about 66 GiB of model storage plus CPU RAM and swap
notes: The NVFP4 checkpoint is not selected for this Ada (RTX 4070) host; use the official BF16 checkpoint with fp8-cast instead.
The official INT8 ConvRot files are ComfyUI-only and are not accepted by this ltx-pipelines wrapper; the official NVFP4 file requires Blackwell (SM >= 10).
The convolutional video VAE is selected to avoid requiring the diffusion VAE attention extra during decode.
The distilled pipeline accepts still-image conditioning through --image PATH FRAME STRENGTH. Use a dedicated LTX pipeline for audio-to-video or video-to-video inputs.

profiles.name: MiniMax Music generation
profiles.description: Standard song generation through the official MiniMax mmx CLI and hosted Music API. This keeps the very large MiniMax-Music3 checkpoint off the 12 GB Yeti GPU.
requirements: MiniMax API authentication configured with mmx auth login
notes: Use --instrumental for an instrumental track or --lyrics for a supplied lyric sheet.
MiniMax-Music3 is not wired into audio.cpp and is not a practical local 12 GB model; the hosted profile is the supported standard path.
